articulation.label: seven
articulation.alt: seven: /s/ → /ɛ/ → /v/ → /ə/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/v/: Upper teeth touch the lower lip; add voice.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

cards.title: Read and write
sections: Heart reads five numbers in a book: fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, and ninety. Puck writes 80 when she says eighty. Later, he reads a phone number one digit at a time. Heart notices that phone numbers and whole amounts are not usually read in the same way.
Which written number does Puck write when Heart says eighty?
Write two sentences using two words from today’s new word bank.
